text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!
Now then, it is time for the race!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The one to seize the glory this time will be
none other than me, a first-rate Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right! You really get it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's go!
To the red carpet that awaits me!
To the shining path of a King!
